note: Proposed taxonomy v0.1. This is a working framework, not an established consensus and not a proven original contribution.

axes.name: Functional position
axes.definition: Where the neural and symbolic components participate in the UAV autonomy stack.

tags.name: Grounding
tags.definition: The system grounds symbols in raw sensor input or translates perception into a symbolic vocabulary.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when a neural component supplies symbols, detections, scene elements, or world state to symbolic reasoning. Exclude when perception is only a conventional detector without semantic coupling.

tags.name: Representation
tags.definition: The work builds or maintains an explicit symbolic representation such as a scene graph, knowledge graph, logical theory, or program.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when the representation has explicit semantics and is used by reasoning. Exclude when a graph is only an internal neural feature map.

tags.name: Reasoning
tags.definition: The work applies logic, constraints, probabilistic logic, or another symbolic inference mechanism.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when symbolic inference affects a decision. Exclude when a neural model merely outputs a label without a symbolic inference step.

tags.name: Planning
tags.definition: The work uses symbolic or neuro-symbolic planning to produce an action sequence, mission, path, or behavior policy.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when neural components inform a symbolic planner or symbolic structure guides a learned policy. Exclude pure neural policy search without symbolic structure.

tags.name: Execution
tags.definition: The work couples a learned controller or skill executor with symbolic constraints, skills, or control structures.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when symbolic constraints guard or parameterize execution. Exclude conventional feedback control unless it is functionally coupled to neural learning.

tags.name: Assurance
tags.definition: The work includes verification, monitoring, shielding, explainability, or formal safety evidence tied to neural-symbolic integration.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when assurance explicitly interacts with learned components. Exclude standalone formal methods on a fixed, purely symbolic model.

axes.name: Integration direction
axes.definition: The dominant direction of information or influence between neural and symbolic components.

tags.name: Neural to symbolic
tags.definition: Neural outputs are lifted into symbols that are then reasoned about.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when perception or neural representation feeds symbolic inference. Do not assume bidirectionality if only one direction is documented.

tags.name: Symbolic to neural
tags.definition: Symbolic knowledge, rules, or structure guide or constrain neural learning.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when symbolic priors affect training, architecture, or objective. Exclude vague claims that rules are used 'somewhere'.

tags.name: Bidirectional
tags.definition: Neural and symbolic components influence each other in a closed loop.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when the paper documents both directions. Bidirectionality is not the only legitimate form of neuro-symbolic integration.

tags.name: Other
tags.definition: A documented integration direction not covered by the other labels.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use only when the paper gives enough detail to justify this label.

tags.name: Unknown
tags.definition: The integration direction is not yet clear from the reviewed material.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when evidence is insufficient; update after fuller review.

axes.name: Symbolic mechanism
axes.definition: The kind of explicit symbolic knowledge representation or inference mechanism.

tags.name: Logic rules
tags.definition: Uses explicit logical rules or constraints.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when rules are represented explicitly and applied to a decision. Exclude heuristic thresholds unless they have clear logical semantics.

tags.name: Probabilistic logic
tags.definition: Uses probabilistic logic programming or uncertain logical inference.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when probabilities and logical structure are jointly reasoned about.

tags.name: Temporal logic
tags.definition: Uses temporal logics such as LTL, STL, or MTL for specifications or monitoring.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when temporal specifications are explicit and coupled to learning. Exclude purely hand-coded monitors without neural coupling.

tags.name: Symbolic planning
tags.definition: Uses classical planning, task planning, or PDDL-like representations.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when a symbolic planner is present. Exclude trajectory optimization without an explicit discrete symbolic model.

tags.name: Knowledge graph
tags.definition: Uses an explicit graph of entities and relations with semantic interpretation.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when graph semantics drive reasoning. Exclude a graph used only as an adjacency matrix for message passing.

tags.name: Scene graph
tags.definition: Uses a scene graph whose nodes and edges have object/attribute/relation semantics.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when the scene graph is consumed by symbolic reasoning. Exclude latent neural scene features without explicit symbolic structure.

tags.name: Program representation
tags.definition: Represents policies or reasoning as programs, DSLs, or executable symbolic artifacts.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when programs are explicitly reasoned about or synthesized with neural components.

tags.name: Constraint reasoning
tags.definition: Uses constraint satisfaction, constraint optimization, or explicit feasibility constraints.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when constraints have explicit semantics. Exclude generic optimization penalties without interpretable constraints.

tags.name: Other
tags.definition: A documented symbolic mechanism not listed above.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use with a written rationale.

tags.name: Unknown
tags.definition: The symbolic mechanism is not yet clear.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when evidence is insufficient.

axes.name: UAV task
axes.definition: The aerial autonomy task or application domain addressed by the work.

tags.name: Navigation
tags.definition: Path following, collision avoidance, or local navigation.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include for motion-level navigation tasks.

tags.name: Mission planning
tags.definition: High-level goal decomposition, task assignment, or mission sequencing.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include for symbolic task/mission planning. Exclude low-level trajectory tracking.

tags.name: Search and exploration
tags.definition: Searching an area, exploring unknown space, or target tracking.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include for search, coverage, and exploration tasks.

tags.name: Landing
tags.definition: Landing-site selection, approach, or safe landing assessment.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include for landing-specific neuro-symbolic methods.

tags.name: Inspection
tags.definition: Infrastructure inspection, fire inspection, or visual survey of structures.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include for inspection/visual survey tasks.

tags.name: Aerial manipulation
tags.definition: Physical interaction or manipulation by a UAV.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include for aerial manipulation tasks.

tags.name: Multi-UAV coordination
tags.definition: Coordination, task allocation, or collective behavior across multiple UAVs.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when multi-UAV interaction is central.

tags.name: Communication and networking
tags.definition: Networked UAV decision-making, communication constraints, or edge-cloud interaction.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Include when networking constraints shape autonomy.

tags.name: Other
tags.definition: Another UAV task or application domain.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use with a written rationale.

axes.name: System and deployment form
axes.definition: The system composition and deployment configuration.

tags.name: Single UAV
tags.definition: The method targets one UAV.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when a single platform is the primary system.

tags.name: Multi-UAV
tags.definition: The method targets multiple cooperating UAVs.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when multiple platforms interact.

tags.name: Human-UAV
tags.definition: The system involves human interaction, oversight, or shared control.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when human input or supervision is central.

tags.name: Edge-cloud
tags.definition: Computation is split between onboard edge resources and cloud or remote resources.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when edge-cloud placement is a material design factor.

tags.name: Heterogeneous robots
tags.definition: The system includes heterogeneous robot types or UAV-ground collaboration.
tags.inclusion_exclusion: Use when heterogeneity affects the method.
